title: Mental images connections
description: Sort 16 words and phrases from today's class into four groups.

groups.name: Pictures in your mind
groups.explanation: Words about creating and having pictures in your head.

groups.name: Strong, weak or missing images
groups.explanation: Words to talk about how clear (or not) your mental pictures are.

groups.name: Eyes, brain and genes
groups.explanation: Words about the body and where our characteristics come from.

groups.name: How scientists study the mind
groups.explanation: Words about studying, testing and comparing how people think.
